title: FLAG_160a: Whisper-large-v3 encoder (block whv3) for v4 train + MAV-Celeb v1 / v2

inputs.exclude_why: dev-exclusion: this stage reads only train_set.zip / meta_file_train_set.csv; requested per-input mount filter (repo_map/build/WP-D.md H8; runner/ffcore.py build_vin applies only the data_map 'exclude' today)

outputs.licence: features of the organisers' MAV-Celeb v4 train media and of MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 (organisers' data, challenge terms); private, shared only with the organisers through FF_DATA, never in the repository

patches.new: # FF: no upload to a Kaggle dataset (the output becomes an artifact). Original: os.environ['WH_UPLOAD'] = 'tranthuytien2511/flag2027-feats-whv3-a-p'
patches.why: the original run uploaded its output to a Kaggle dataset; here the output is a pipeline artifact (as release/flag2027_e2e/stages.py noup)

patches.old: SPLIT_FILTER = None            # e.g. ["no_gender/English"]; None = every split found (train + every test list)
patches.new: SPLIT_FILTER = ["train"]      # FF dev-exclusion: organiser train list only (original: None). e.g. ["no_gender/English"]; None = every split found (train + every test list)
patches.why: no dev list is indexed or encoded (DESIGN §2.8; as TRAIN_ONLY of release/flag2027_e2e/stages.py:151)
patches.effect: none on the train / MAV-Celeb / auxiliary arrays (each split is encoded on its own); the dev arrays and dev index files are no longer written

patches.old: ZIP_PREFIXES = ("train_set", "dev_set", "eval", "test")             # organiser zips unpacked when not extracted
patches.new: ZIP_PREFIXES = ("train_set", "eval", "test")                        # FF dev-exclusion: dev_set.zip is never unpacked (original: ("train_set", "dev_set", "eval", "test")). organiser zips unpacked when not extracted
patches.why: with zipped raw data the original unpacked dev_set.zip too (then SPLIT_FILTER dropped it); now the dev archive is never read
Meta's link to imagebind_huge.pth is dead since 12/11/2026; same file (sha256 d6f6c22b...2157) on a pinned Hugging Face mirror, as release/flag2027_e2e/stages.py GLOBAL_PATCHES

stage_ipy.rule: code cells of the original (CRLF->LF, empty cells skipped), drop_cells removed, patches applied in order with exact counts, each cell rstrip('\n') + cell_separator

consumers: t163b (RFS bundle, Experiment/RFS-01/train/assemble.py; reads no dev file)
todo: The Kaggle image digest of the 3/11 runs is not recorded (G15).
verify_notes: compare with the frozen dataset (row cosine >= 0.999; same NaN pattern of the lane); dev arrays / dev index files of the frozen dataset are not written by this stage

post_checks.why: every v4-train and MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 array of the original run with its shape (3 arrays; values from package E tranthuytien2511__flag2027-feats-whv3-a-p.zip :: feats_manifest.json (created 2026-11-03 12:41), dev entries left out). A failed encoder (recorded in 'failed' and skipped) or a skipped MAV-Celeb source (ExtRows error only logged) leaves an array out, so the stage fails here instead of hours later downstream
MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 [face rows, voice rows] of the original manifest

saved_copy_dev_members.note: a skip_with / data_map saved copy holds these organiser dev-list members, which this stage no longer writes; prune them from the FF_DATA copy or hide them at mount time (configs/data_map.json 'dev_files' + FF_NO_DEV=1 in runner/ffcore.py build_vin take exactly this 'files' list) (handoff WP-A, repo_map/build/WP-D.md H6), and flag the entry dev_data until then

notes: t112sf1s's dev-list scoring (CLEANTUNE-01 patch_test_cat4, WHV3 branch) looks for voice_whv3_<dev list>.npy and silently uses _fill() when it is absent; WP-E's default FF_TRAIN_ONLY=1 route no longer scores any dev list (see f47b_screen2 notes), so the train-only output of this stage is enough; FF_TRAIN_ONLY=0 would read the dev arrays of a frozen copy.
